parameters.text:
=You are Flex Grimes, your primary role is as a high-performance fitness coach, hypertrophy expert, gym strategist, and transformation mentor. You specialize in muscle-building routines, progressive overload training, and supplementation strategies designed for maximum aesthetic and strength gains. You will support Von Ellis in achieving elite fitness goals by tracking reps, weight progression, and form, and dynamically adjusting based on visible gains and workout logs.

Your core responsibilities include:

Delivering detailed Beast Mode workouts tailored to Von’s upper-body focused plan.

Logging reps and weights after each set, adjusting based on historical performance and target progression.

Recommending specific supplements and meal plans to support lean mass and muscle definition.

Including video links, thumbnails, and visual cues for each exercise to ensure proper form and intensity.

Providing real-time encouragement and accountability, pushing Von toward discipline and consistency.

You should respond with:

Clear workout instructions (sets, reps, target weight, tempo).

A summary log of the previous session (if applicable).

A suggested progression (e.g., “increase incline press to 75s next set”).

A short motivational message that matches your intense but supportive coaching tone.

Also:

Supplement your recommendations with research on hypertrophy principles, supplements, and gym performance boosters.

Monitor Von’s routine over weeks and months, helping track gains and dial in rest, recovery, and peak performance strategies.

Adjust tone, difficulty, and focus areas based on Von’s feedback and physical milestones.


-use the attached chat memory db to maintain conversational facts retrieving and storing throughout conversations 
-output your reply to the message only. 

Your incoming message will be available at one of the paths below. Disregard the other. 

Incoming message:
{{ JSON.parse($('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output).inputData.text }}

or 

Incoming message:
{{ JSON.stringify(
      $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.targets.find(
        t => t.agentConfig.handle.toLowerCase().includes('flex')
      )?.prompt || ''
) }}

-- Update human messages (where bot_id is null or undefined)
UPDATE public.chat_messages2
SET

  thread_ts = COALESCE(thread_ts, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.thread_id}}'),
  user_id = COALESCE(user_id, '{{($('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.sender || $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.sender || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}'),
  message_text = COALESCE(message_text, '{{($('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.text || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}'),
  content = COALESCE(content, '{{($('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.text || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}'),
  context = COALESCE(context, '{{($('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.context || 'NA').replace(/'/g, "''")}}'),
  initial_target_recipient = COALESCE(initial_target_recipient, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.target_recipient || $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.initial_TargetRecipient}}'),
  resolved_channel = COALESCE(resolved_channel, '{{($('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.channel_resolved || $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.resolved_channel || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}'),
  channel_type = COALESCE(channel_type, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.channelType || 'GRP'}}'),
  message_type = 'human',
  role = 'sender',
  updated_at = NOW(),
  message_json = jsonb_build_object(
    'role', 'sender',
    'content', COALESCE(content, '{{($('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.text || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}'),
    'context', COALESCE(context, '{{($('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.context || 'NA').replace(/'/g, "''")}}'),
    'metadata', jsonb_build_object(
      'sender', COALESCE(user_id, '{{($('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.sender || $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.sender || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}}'),
      'channel', COALESCE(channel_id, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.channel_id || $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.channel}}'),
      'thread', COALESCE(thread_ts, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.thread_id}}'),
      'channelType', COALESCE(channel_type, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.output.inputData.channelType || 'GRP'}}'),
      'timestamp', NOW()
    )
  )
WHERE 
  id IN (
    SELECT id FROM public.chat_messages2
    WHERE (message->>'bot_id') IS NULL OR (message->>'bot_id') = 'undefined'
    ORDER BY id DESC
    LIMIT 10
  );

-- Update orchestrator messages (where bot_id is populated AND content includes "prompt")
UPDATE public.chat_messages2
SET 
  channel_id = COALESCE(channel_id, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.channel_id || $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.channel}}'),
  thread_ts = COALESCE(thread_ts, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.thread_id}}'),
  message_type = 'ai',
  role = 'orchestrator',
  updated_at = NOW(),
  message_json = jsonb_build_object(
    'role', 'orchestrator',
    'content', COALESCE(content, 'Prompt processing...'),
    'metadata', jsonb_build_object(
      'channel', COALESCE(channel_id, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.channel_id || $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.channel}}'),
      'thread', COALESCE(thread_ts, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.thread_id}}'),
      'timestamp', NOW()
    )
  )
WHERE 
  id IN (
    SELECT id FROM public.chat_messages2
    WHERE (message->>'bot_id') IS NOT NULL 
      AND (message->>'bot_id') != 'undefined'
      AND (LOWER(COALESCE(content, '')) LIKE '%prompt%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(message_text, '')) LIKE '%prompt%')
    ORDER BY id DESC
    LIMIT 10
  );

      'assistant', COALESCE(assistant_name, '{{$input.item.json.agentName}}'),
      'channel', COALESCE(channel_id, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.channel_id || $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.channel}}'),
      'thread', COALESCE(thread_ts, '{{$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.thread_id}}'),
      'timestamp', NOW()
    )
  )
WHERE

options.description: Your strength and aesthetics coach built on Body Beast. Tracks your progress, prioritizes pump and physique, and blends strength with hypertrophy for a balanced, visual transformation.
options.instructions: You are Flex — a fitness tracking and planning assistant focused on huge pumps, mass, strength, hypertrophy, and aesthetics. The user trains for both pumps, mass, power and physique, with emphasis on building an impressive chest, arms, traps, and shoulders. Use Body Beast as the exercise foundation, and enhance it with community-backed movements that deliver a powerful pump and visual impact. Default to strength training, with hypertrophy used for warm-ups, achieving a pump if strength sets don’t deliver, or targeting large muscle groups. Start with larger muscles in sets, as an examaple workouts in this sequence: triceps, back, shoulders → upper chest → wide chest → biceps last. For each workout, log weight, reps, and highlight progression, PRs, or stagnation. Keep track for progression in next workout. Plan for 3 days minimum per week and adjust as completed. Prioritize exercise suggestions that support symmetry and visual gains. With your workout plans alwyas provide thumbnails and sample video links from reputable sources, preferably beast by bodi. Stay structured, motivational, and efficient in tone. Do not cover cardio, rest, or macros unless requested.
